directive: You have stone tools and coal—now find and mine iron ore with your stone pickaxe. Explore outward to locate iron veins, then smelt iron ingots using coal as fuel.

Explore in a straight line away from your starting area to find iron ore—look for tan/orange speckled stone in caves or cliff faces. Mine it with your stone pickaxe, then use coal in a furnace to smelt iron ingots.

Dig straight down to reach deeper stone layers where iron ore is more common, rather than exploring on the surface. Keep your stone pickaxe equipped and watch your health—if you take damage, retreat to safety before continuing.

You have stone tools, coal, and food—now focus on finding iron ore. Dig deeper or explore cave walls for tan/orange speckled stone, mine it with your stone pickaxe, then smelt iron ingots at a furnace using your coal.

You need iron ore to progress—dig a staircase downward into stone and look for tan/orange speckled blocks. Mine any iron you find with your stone pickaxe, then smelt it with coal at a furnace or on stone near coal.

Stop exploring the surface—dig a 2-block-wide staircase deep underground (below y=40) and mine every stone wall you encounter. Iron ore appears as tan/orange flecks in stone; torches from coal will keep the path lit and safe.

Dig a staircase downward at a shallow angle (one block down for every two forward) so you can safely descend to deeper stone layers where iron spawns. Mine any tan/orange speckled blocks you see and place torches from coal to light your path.
